purpose: Numeric fingerprint of the synthetic method demo, so a future mismatch lands on a number instead of on image pixels. Checked by analysis/tests/test_demo_reproducibility.py.
why_not_compare_png: The PNG cannot be diffed across machines: font rasterisation differs between freetype builds, so the title and footer text bands differ by ~21,000 pixels while every data pixel is identical. See method_demo_synthetic.env.json.
cross_version_check: Scene sha256 and all six candidate endpoints are bit-identical under numpy 2.1.3 / scipy 1.14.1 and numpy 2.4.6 / scipy 1.17.1, and both environments render a byte-identical PNG.
